Cellular & Taxonomic Lineage Composition Stacked Bars with Clinical Track

Source: R/type_composition.R
type_composition.Rd

Creates publication-ready cellular or taxonomic lineage composition stacked bar charts (Clinical Archetype 37) with an integrated bottom clinical phenotype track (e.g. disease severity, treatment cohort, or responder status).

Addresses the classic ggplot2 single-fill limitation by mapping lineage fractions to stacked bar fill while rendering the clinical metadata track via discrete colored segments, allowing both legends to coexist harmoniously.

Usage

type_composition(
  sample_col = NULL,
  lineage_col = NULL,
  share_col = NULL,
  track_col = NULL,
  facet_col = NULL,
  track_y = -0.05,
  track_linewidth = 2.4,
  palette = "nature",
  track_palette = NULL,
  lineage_name = "Cell Lineage",
  track_name = "Clinical Group",
  show_percentages = TRUE,
  reorder_by_track = TRUE,
  xlab = NULL,
  ylab = NULL
)

Arguments

sample_col

Column name for sample or library identifiers.

lineage_col

Column name for cellular lineages or taxa.

share_col

Column name for fractional proportions (0 to 1) or abundance.

track_col

Column name for clinical group, disease stage, or treatment arm.

facet_col

Column name for dataset or cohort faceting.

track_y

Vertical position of the clinical phenotype strip below baseline (default -0.05).

track_linewidth

Thickness of the clinical track segment (default 2.4).

palette

Discrete color palette name or vector of colors for cell lineages (default "nature").

track_palette

Discrete color vector or palette name for clinical groups.

lineage_name

Legend title for cell lineages (default "Cell Lineage").

track_name

Legend title for clinical phenotype track (default "Clinical Group").

show_percentages

Logical. If TRUE (default), formats y-axis as percentages (0% to 100%).

reorder_by_track

Logical. If TRUE (default), orders samples along x-axis by clinical group then sample ID.

xlab, ylab

Axis labels.

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(cliomicplot)
data(immune_cell_composition)

# Lineage composition with clinical phenotype track
cliplot(
  share ~ gsm,
  data = immune_cell_composition,
  type = type_composition(
    lineage_col = "lineage",
    track_col = "group",
    facet_col = "dataset"
  ),
  title = "Single-Cell Leukocyte Lineage Composition Across Allergic Cohorts"
)
} # }
